blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The project engineer of the allegedly substandard road dike project in Oriental Mindoro told the Sandiganbayan Sixth Division on Thursday that he needed to rely on the reports of contractor Sunwest at times when he or his staff were not around to personally inspect the activities for the project.
